### 🎶 **Suno Prompt – Cinematic Deep House with Anatolian Fusion**

> **Style:** cinematic deep house, clarinet, darbuka, darbuca, saz, oud, kanun, qanun  
> **Mood:** hypnotic, atmospheric, soulful, mystical  
> **Vocal style:** minimal, expressive, breathy falsetto with melismatic phrasing drifting through reverb  
> **Tempo:** slow-burning, weightless groove (~90–110 BPM)

---

### 🧠 **Prompt Text**  
A hypnotic blend of **Anatolian mystique** and **cinematic deep house**, inspired by **Mahmut Orhan’s signature style**. The groove is anchored by **velvet-soft house kicks** and **pulsing analog bass**, layered with traditional Turkish instrumentation: **saz riffs**, **oud**, **kanun**, **qanun**, **live darbuka rhythms**, and **ambient ney phrases**.  

**Kanun and string swells** rise like emotional tides, while **reversed zurna accents** flash between vocal lines. The texture is enriched with **airy synth pads**, **filtered vinyl hiss**, and **field recordings**, creating immersive depth.  

Vocals are **minimal but expressive**, with **breathy falsetto** and **melismatic phrasing** floating through long **reverb trails**. The track flows like a **spiritual journey**—slow-burning, cinematic, and serene. Ideal for **twilight dancefloors**, **sacred spaces**, or **desert sunsets**.

---

### ❌ **Exclude**  
Do **not** include: trap, drill, phonk, brostep, hyperpop, glitchcore, hard techno, metal, industrial, aggressive vocals, overprocessed layering, or fast BPM (>130).

### 🎨 Notable Orientalist Interior Paintings

   - Illustrates the interior of a mosque with worshippers, highlighting the play of light and shadow within the sacred space.
   - [View at Memorial Art Gallery, Rochester, NY](https://mag.rochester.edu/collections/jean-leon-gerome-interior-of-a-mosque/)

3. **John Frederick Lewis – *The Reception* (1873)**
   - Portrays a tranquil domestic scene in a Cairo home, emphasizing the intricate décor and the leisurely pace of life.
   - [Learn more about John Frederick Lewis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Frederick_Lewis)

4. **Jean-Joseph Benjamin-Constant – *A Royal Palace in Morocco***
   - Captures the opulence of a Moroccan palace interior, complete with ornate arches and luxurious furnishings.
   - [View on Fine Art America](https://fineartamerica.com/featured/a-royal-palace-in-morocco-by-jean-joseph-benjamin-constant-arkitekta-art.html)

5. **Rudolf Ernst – *The Almeh* (Late 19th Century)**
   - Features a dancer performing in a lavishly decorated room, highlighting the textures of fabrics and architectural elements.
   - [Explore Rudolf Ernst's works](https://www.christies.com/en/lot/lot-5772067)
